simple.summary: קָבַע (qâbaʻ) means to cover , i.e. (figuratively) defraud First listed occurrence: Mal 3 8.

definitions.full: H6906. qaba קָבַע verb dubious, perhaps rob (synonym גזל , so Rabb (rare), see De Pr 22, 23 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive וְקָכַע Prov 22:23 , subject ׳י , with accusative of person + thing; with accusative pers alone 1 plural קְבַעֲנוּךָ כַּמֶּה Mal 3:8 (object ׳י ); Imperfect 3masculine singular אֱלֹהִים אָדָם הֲיִקְבַּע 3:8 ; Participle active אֹתִי קֹבְעִים אַתֶּם 3:8 ; 3:9 ; suffix קֹבְעֵיהֶם Prov 22:23 those robbing them. — In Malachi ᵐ5 We עָקַב circumvent.
